title: Akmagnus Prime
extract:
The Akmagnus Prime is the Primed variant of the  Akmagnus dual heavy pistols, with improvements to its critical chance, critical multiplier, and status chance, and slightly faster reload speed. Its shots also uniquely have a chance to grant it 100% Ammo Efficiency for a short duration.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Impact damage.
Landing a successful hit (including from Multishot) or inflicting Status damage ( Slash,  Heat,  Toxin,  Electricity,  Blast, and  Gas procs) with Akmagnus Prime has a 4% chance to grant the "Chamber Cascade" buff, increasing Ammo Efficiency by 100% for 4 seconds and can be refreshed on subsequent shots.

Acquisition
The Void Relics containing the Akmagnus Prime components can be purchased from Baro Ki'Teer in the Concourse section of the Tenno Relay for  55,000 and  125 each. Note that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance and this relic may not be available on a succeeding appearance.

Crafting

Tips
Akmagnus Prime's Chamber Cascade is functionally identical to that of the normal Magnus Prime's. As a result, anything that applies to the one-handed variant applies to this weapon as well.
Each hit has a chance to activate the passive, refreshing the duration if it's already active. With sufficient multishot, punch through, and fire rate, 100% Ammo Efficiency can be maintained indefinitely.
Damage-over-time debuffs also count as hits, allowing an Akmagnus Prime with the right elements applied even more uptime of Chamber Cascade. DoT's can even allow for the buff to persists for more than 4 seconds after not directly attacking any enemies.
Like many other semi-automatic akimbo pistols, Akmagnus Prime generates noticeable recoil when fired as fast as possible, especially if modded above its base fire rate. Activating Chamber Cascade will exacerbate this, as it encourages the weapon to be fired quickly to spend as much free ammo as possible while the buff lasts, as well as refresh it.

Trivia
Magnus is Latin for "Big" or "Great". The "Ak-" prefix - present in the name of several of Warframe's dual pistol weapons - is short for "akimbo", which is the name of the gesture of putting one's hands on their hips with their elbows turned outwards, which has become slang for the act of dual-wielding one-handed weapons in popular culture.
Akmagnus Prime was unintentionally mentioned in Hotfix 36.0.7 (2024-07-22)'s patch notes before its release: "Fixed being unable to chat link the Akmagnus Prime."
